items.raw_excerpt: It's likely you've already chewed and swallowed some tasty morsel today. But when did that ability emerge? New evidence points to at least the middle Jurassic, back when dinosaurs still reigned.
items.summary_en: Scientists found a fossil of a small, platypus-like mammal. It is from the middle Jurassic, when dinosaurs lived. The fossil shows this animal could chew and swallow its food.
items.summary_ko: 과학자들이 오리너구리를 닮은 작은 포유류 화석을 찾았어요. 이 화석은 공룡이 살던 중기 쥐라기 시대의 것이에요. 이 동물이 음식을 씹고 삼킬 수 있었다는 사실을 보여줍니다.
items.title_en: Old mammal fossil shows when chewing began
items.title_ko: 아주 오래된 포유류 화석, 씹는 능력의 시작을 보여줘
items.title_original: This surprising mammal fossil is giving scientists something to chew on

items.raw_excerpt: Santa Maria da Feira will install video surveillance at city entrances and key locations in the historic centre, the municipality announced today.
items.summary_en: Santa Maria da Feira in Portugal will put video cameras at city entrances and key places in its old town. The city announced the plan to help watch over these busy areas. It is a small step to make the streets feel safer.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈의 산타 마리아 다 페이라 시가 시내 진입로와 구시가지 주요 지점에 영상 감시 카메라를 설치한다. 시는 이 계획을 발표하며 사람들이 많이 다니는 지역을 살피겠다고 밝혔다. 거리를 더 안전하게 만들기 위한 작은 조치다.
items.title_en: Portuguese city to add video cameras in key spots
items.title_ko: 포르투갈 도시, 주요 지역에 영상 감시 카메라 설치

items.raw_excerpt: A Póvoa de São Cosme, no concelho de Oliveira do Hospital, foi escolhida como “Aldeia dos Sonhos 2025/2026”, uma iniciativa…
items.summary_en: Maria is 91 years old and lives in Oliveira do Hospital, Portugal. Her village was chosen as the Dream Village of the year. Thanks to this project, she will travel to see the ocean for the very first time in her life.

items.raw_excerpt: An elite tactical unit called out after a suspicious box of churros were left on the Mexico City Metro quickly made the problem disappear.
items.summary_en: Police in Mexico City called in an elite tactical unit after a box of churros was left on the Metro. The suspicious box turned out to be harmless. The bomb squad cleared the scene and the problem quickly disappeared.

items.raw_excerpt: Singing in church and being intimidated by Paul Kelly helped Vika and Linda Bull find their own stories. Four decades later, they are more confident than ever.

items.raw_excerpt: The eastern coast of Mexico made it through September without a hurricane, its first hurricane-free September in more than three decades.
items.summary_en: Mexico's eastern coast made it through September without a single hurricane. It was the first hurricane-free September there in more than 30 years.

items.raw_excerpt: A once-abundant snail nearly disappeared as weirs and irrigation diverted water from its river home. But it found protection in the very structures that almost wiped it out.
items.summary_en: A small snail was once common in the Darling River. Weirs and water diversions almost wiped it out. Now the snails are surviving on those same structures.
items.summary_ko: 한때 달링강에 흔했던 작은 달팽이가 거의 사라졌다. 보와 물길 시설이 달팽이의 서식지를 앗아갔다. 이제 달팽이는 그 같은 구조물에서 다시 살아가고 있다.
items.title_en: Nearly extinct Darling River snails found living on man-made weirs

items.summary_en: Trevor Gleeson was shocked after getting a technical foul in the 36ers' loss to Melbourne United. The coach said he felt the referees were targeting him during the NBL Ignite Cup game.
